questions.question: 1. Young's double slit experiment demonstrates the

explanations.a: Incorrect: Particle nature is demonstrated by the photoelectric effect, not YDSE.
explanations.b: Correct: YDSE produces interference fringes, which is a wave phenomenon.
explanations.c: Incorrect: Light has no thermal nature in this context.
explanations.d: Incorrect: Light is not an electrical phenomenon in this context.

questions.question: 2. Constructive interference occurs when the path difference between two waves is

explanations.a: Incorrect: This is the condition for destructive interference.
explanations.b: Correct: Path difference = nλ leads to constructive interference (n = 0, 1, 2, …).
explanations.c: Incorrect: λ/4 does not directly correspond to constructive or destructive interference.
explanations.d: Incorrect: n = 0 is one special case; all integer multiples of λ give constructive interference.

questions.question: 3. The condition for destructive interference in Young's double slit experiment is

explanations.a: Incorrect: This is the condition for constructive interference (bright fringes).
explanations.b: Correct: Half-integer path difference causes complete cancellation (dark fringes).
explanations.c: Incorrect: This is only the n = 1 bright fringe condition.
explanations.d: Incorrect: 2nλ is not the standard condition for dark fringes.

questions.question: 4. The fringe width β in Young's double slit experiment is given by

explanations.a: Incorrect: The formula inverts the correct relationship.
explanations.b: Incorrect: This has the wrong arrangement of variables.
explanations.c: Correct: β = λD/d is the standard fringe-width formula.
explanations.d: Incorrect: This would increase with d, which contradicts the physics.

questions.question: 5. Two sources are said to be coherent if they

answers.b: Emit waves of varying phase difference
answers.c: Have the same frequency and constant phase difference
answers.d: Are placed very close to each other

explanations.a: Incorrect: Coherent sources must have the same wavelength.
explanations.b: Incorrect: A varying phase difference destroys coherence and hence fringes.
explanations.c: Correct: Coherence requires identical frequency and a time-invariant phase difference.
explanations.d: Incorrect: Proximity alone does not make sources coherent.

questions.question: 6. Who performed the original double slit experiment to demonstrate the wave nature of light?

explanations.a: Incorrect: Newton proposed the corpuscular (particle) theory of light.
explanations.b: Incorrect: Einstein explained the photoelectric effect using photons.
explanations.c: Correct: Thomas Young performed the double slit experiment in 1801.
explanations.d: Incorrect: Maxwell developed the electromagnetic theory of light.

questions.question: 7. In YDSE, what is the path difference at the central bright fringe?

explanations.a: Incorrect: λ/2 path difference gives destructive interference.
explanations.b: Incorrect: λ corresponds to the first bright fringe (n=1), not the central one.
explanations.c: Incorrect: 2λ corresponds to the second order bright fringe.
explanations.d: Correct: At the centre, both slits are equidistant so path difference = 0, giving maximum intensity.

questions.question: 8. In YDSE, if the distance D from slits to screen is increased, the fringe width β

explanations.a: Incorrect: β = λD/d, so increasing D increases β.
explanations.b: Correct: β is directly proportional to D.
explanations.c: Incorrect: Fringe width is not independent of D.
explanations.d: Incorrect: β cannot become zero unless D = 0.

questions.question: 9. The phase difference corresponding to a path difference of λ (one wavelength) is

explanations.a: Incorrect: Phase difference π corresponds to path difference λ/2.
explanations.b: Incorrect: Phase difference π/2 corresponds to path difference λ/4.
explanations.c: Correct: One complete wavelength (λ) corresponds to a phase difference of 2π radians.
explanations.d: Incorrect: Phase difference 4π corresponds to path difference 2λ.

questions.question: 10. In YDSE, if the wavelength of light used is increased, the fringe width β

explanations.a: Incorrect: β = λD/d, so β increases with λ.
explanations.b: Incorrect: Fringe width depends on wavelength.
explanations.c: Correct: β is directly proportional to λ.
explanations.d: Incorrect: β becomes zero only if λ = 0.
